final: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.name, g.avg_price, g.avg_bpms, g.avg_bpms / o.overall AS ratio FROM g, o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL
